note: 此刻那一本主线节点原画的场面稿，第二轮之二：主城三幕主线 #1175 到 #1183 余下的十八幕。

nodes.name: 横井
who: the copper-red-haired agent in the black jacket
nodes.light: a thin bright thread of white-gold light from the needle of sand in the archer's palm, against the brown-black dark of a tunnel, with dim grey daylight falling through a hole in the roof
nodes.camera: low on the tunnel floor, close to the two women, looking along the tunnel and up through the broken roof at the sagging street above; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: inside a tunnel as wide as a street, freshly gnawed through earth and masonry deep under a city; its walls are ribbed with huge tooth-marks. The tunnel has swallowed pieces of the city above and they lie in it the wrong way round: iron street lamps stick out of the wall sideways, half of a public notice wall with blank torn posters stands buried to its middle in mud, a shelf of document boxes hangs upside down from the roof, and at the bend ahead a small bronze tower-bell is wedged between two stones. Overhead the roof has broken open, and through the hole we see from below a street that is sinking: paving sagging like cloth, a row of house fronts leaning inward, a cart tipping at the edge. On the right, standing in full profile facing left toward the bend, is a small young woman of twenty, an archer with short unevenly cut sand-blonde hair, a patched leather jerkin over a long-sleeved shirt, and on her back a hunting bow with its upper limb snapped off, bound in cloth. She holds her left hand open, palm up, before her chest; over it floats a thin needle of glittering sand that shines white-gold and points down the tunnel. Her right hand rests on the wall. Her face is tense and intent. Beside her on the left, seen directly from behind, stands the copper-red-haired agent in the black jacket, long copper-red hair with softly curled ends, a short blade held low in her right hand and her left hand raised to touch the wedged bell and keep it still. Far down the tunnel two small figures sit roped together against the wall, alive, lifting their heads. Dust and grains of bright sand drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：吞街兽啃出的地道从井壁打到钟楼区底下，头顶的街一段一段往下陷，治安所的档案室倒扣在地道里，一口小钟卡在拐角。远处是两个救得回的队友。

nodes.name: 兽背掌链
nodes.light: a blinding white-gold glare from the chained star on the beast's back, lighting the whole tunnel like day, with black shadow and falling dust behind
nodes.camera: low on a tilted slab in the tunnel, close behind the crouching archer, looking up at the back of the beast as it charges away from us; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a tunnel as wide as a street under a city, and it is collapsing. Ahead of us, charging away down the tunnel and filling it from wall to wall, is a beast as big as a row of houses: a burrowing thing plated like a huge pangolin, its back armoured with slabs that the heat of a star has baked pale and hard. On its back, lashed down under a web of heavy iron chains, rides a fallen star: a jagged ball of white-gold crystal the size of a house, so bright that the whole tunnel is lit like noon and every stone throws a black shadow. On the beast's back beside the star stands a lean man in a long weathered coat, the boss of a rope crew, in full profile facing left: grey stubble, a wide-brimmed hat tied under his chin, coils of chain and rope over his shoulder. His left hand grips the main chain of the star like a rein; his right arm has just swung a grappling hook on a long line up over his head, and the hook has bitten into a roof beam of the tunnel behind the beast. Where the line has gone taut the beam is tearing loose, and the whole roof of the tunnel between the beast and us is coming down in a slope of stone and timber. In the near foreground, on a tilted slab of paving, a small young woman crouches seen directly from behind: short unevenly cut sand-blonde hair, a patched leather jerkin, a broken bow on her back. Her left hand is flat on the slab; her right hand holds an iron climbing hook ready; her knees are bent to leap. Falling stones and grains of bright sand streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：吞街兽驮着环星冲向外环城墙，马洛里站在兽背上掌链，钩索一甩，身后的整段地道塌下来。马洛里的样子卡里只说是绳队的头，补成瘦长、长外套、宽檐帽。

nodes.name: 斗场
nodes.light: hot orange torchlight from brackets round a sunken pit, against deep brown-black shadow, with one dull red glow from the collar on the griffin's neck
nodes.camera: from inside a barred gate at the level of the arena floor, close behind the young squire's shoulder, looking through the bars across the sand; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in a secret fighting pit built in an old cistern under a city: a round floor of sand ringed by a high wall, torches in iron brackets, and above the wall boxes hung with rich cloth where masked nobles in fine coats and gowns sit with wine cups, small and half in shadow. Round the pit stand beast cages, and on every cage door a single feather is branded into the iron. In the middle of the sand stands a young sun griffin, eagle-headed and lion-bodied, its feathers a dulled gold: a broad iron collar is locked round its neck, set with a red stone that glows, and chains run from the collar to two posts; its wings are strapped shut against its sides and its head hangs low, the eyes dull and half closed. Beside it, in full profile facing left toward it, stands a beast tamer in black lacquered armour and a closed helm, holding in his right hand a long goad with a hook and in his left a loop of the chain. Beyond them a lion with two heads paces at the foot of the wall, both heads turned toward the gate. In the near foreground, inside a barred gate at the level of the sand, a young squire stands seen directly from behind: short wheat-coloured hair, plain half-plate too wide for her shoulders, a golden feather tucked into the back of her belt. Both her hands grip the bars at the height of her face, the knuckles tight, and she leans her whole weight against them. Sparks from the torches and motes of sand drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：旧水道通到贵族私开的魔兽斗场，双头狮和黑甲驯兽师守着兽笼，狮鹫在这里待得越久越不像它自己。笼门上烙着一根羽毛（霍雷肖的记号）。卡萝只画背影。

nodes.name: 太阳门上
nodes.light: blazing gold sunrise straight behind the great gate, with long rays through its arch, deep blue shadow on the near sides of the flyers and a small red glow from the collar
nodes.camera: in the air level with the two griffins, from the side, with the gate below and behind them; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: sunrise in the air above the great gate of a white and gold imperial capital: a monumental gate with a huge golden sun disc set above its arch, the city wall running away on both sides, the roofs of the city small below. Two griffins are flying from left to right across the picture, seen from the side. The one in front, on the right, is a young sun griffin with gold feathers, a broad iron collar with a glowing red stone locked round its neck; it flies stiffly, with dull eyes. On its back, in a high-backed saddle, in full profile facing right, rides a gaunt man of fifty in a rich dark travelling coat with a feather brooch at the collar and gloves, his thin grey hair blown back; his left hand holds the reins short, and his right hand has just thrown open the door of one of a row of iron cages that hang behind his saddle. Out of the open cages burst three winged serpents, each with a small armoured rider, curving back toward the pursuer. Behind and a little below, on the left, flies a second, older griffin with scarred wings and no saddle. On its bare back, in full profile facing right, rides a young squire of eighteen: short wheat-coloured hair streaming back, plain half-plate too wide for her shoulders, a golden feather in her belt. Her left hand is knotted in the feathers of the griffin's neck; her right arm is stretched straight forward, fingers spread, reaching for the collar on the griffin ahead. Her teeth are set and her eyes are fixed on the red stone. Golden feathers and sparks of sun streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：霍雷肖骑着戴项圈的狮鹫往城外逃，鞍后的笼门一开放出翼蛇骑士，卡萝骑着刚救出来的那一头追，半空里谁先够到那只项圈。霍雷肖的样子卡里没写，补成瘦、五十上下、领口一枚羽毛扣。地方参考用金鸢城全景。

nodes.name: 空台
who: the young saintess in white robes with a thin gold circlet
nodes.light: a clean silver-white light from the flame in the young nun's hands, growing brighter as it nears the empty dais, against the grey-blue dark of a deep crypt
nodes.camera: low on the floor of the crypt, to one side of the dais, looking across it at the two women and up at the worn figure on the wall; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the lowest chamber of a crypt far below a cathedral: a round vault of pale stone, very old and very quiet, dust undisturbed on the floor. The stair by which the two women came down is blocked behind them by a fresh fall of rubble and broken vaulting. In the middle of the chamber stands a long stone dais made to hold holy remains, with carved sides and a canopy of stone, and it is empty: nothing lies on it but dust and a few withered wreaths. On the wall behind the dais is a tall worn relief of a winged guardian standing watch with a lowered sword, six wings folded; its face has been worn quite smooth, so that it has no features at all. Round the dais float seven small splinters of silver-white fire, each no bigger than a candle flame, drifting slowly toward one another. On the left, standing before the dais in full profile facing right, is a young nun of nineteen: short flax-coloured hair under a white veil with a few strands loose, pale blue eyes, a plain long-sleeved habit with scorch-marked cuffs. Both her hands are cupped before her chest round a silver-white flame, which leans toward the dais like a flame in a draught and burns brighter. She looks at the smooth face on the wall, listening. Behind her on the far left, seen directly from behind, stands the young saintess in white robes with a thin gold circlet, soft golden hair past her shoulders, her staff in her right hand and her left hand raised to her mouth. White motes and dust drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：一层一层往下拾圣火碎片，身后的拱顶塌了，最底下那一层空着一座圣骸台。墙上那一位没有脸的守望者是照“被遗忘的守护天使”补的浮雕，页上只说“无人记得的守望”。

nodes.name: 祭坛
who: the young saintess with a thin gold circlet
nodes.light: seven points of silver-white fire in the young nun's hands in the middle, against a huge darkness that drinks the coloured light out of the windows above, with a ring of small orange torches
nodes.camera: low in the nave, close behind the saintess, looking up the altar steps and on up into the dome; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night inside a great cathedral of white stone. The floor of the nave has burst upward, and out of the hole a thing has risen as high as the dome: a shape of solid darkness in the outline of an armoured figure with six wings, featureless, cut off by the top of the frame. Wherever its wings pass before the tall coloured windows, the light of the windows goes out, as if drunk; the glass behind it hangs black. At the top of the altar steps, in the middle of the picture, a young nun of nineteen stands on the high altar platform, facing us: her white veil is gone and her short flax-coloured hair is loose, she wears a plain long-sleeved habit, and she is unhurt. Both her hands are held out before her, cupped, and in them seven splinters of silver-white fire blaze together so brightly that her whole figure is edged with white. Her eyes are lifted to the dark thing above us. Close behind her left shoulder stands the chief priest, a tall heavy man of sixty in white and gold vestments with a long stole hung with keys, facing us, his right hand gripping her shoulder and his left hand pointing at her, his mouth open in denunciation. Round the altar platform stand twelve friars in grey habits with their hoods up, each holding a burning torch; several of them are looking up at the dark thing and letting their torches droop. In the near foreground at the foot of the steps, seen directly from behind, stands the young saintess with a thin gold circlet, soft golden hair past her shoulders, her staff raised in both hands. White sparks and flakes of dark ash streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：无名恶魔破封，从地底一路打上大教堂的穹顶，杜兰德把安洁押上主祭坛，执火修士举着火把围了一圈，圣火碎片在她手里一齐发烫。恶魔画成吞光的六翼黑影。

nodes.name: 断蹄印
nodes.light: a soft silver glow from a shed antler tine in the ranger's hand, against the blue-green dusk of a deep forest, with a last amber light low between the trunks on the left
nodes.camera: very low, almost on the forest floor beside the hoofprints, looking up at the kneeling ranger; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk at the edge of an ancient forest of gigantic trees. On the soft earth a line of large cloven hoofprints, each filled with a faint silver shine, comes toward us and stops dead: the last print lies half under a sheet of grey spider silk that is stretched across the ground and up between two roots. Beyond that, a trail of small shed antler tines, silver and softly glowing, leads away one after another into the black of the deeper wood, where more silk hangs between the trunks. In the middle, kneeling on one knee beside the last hoofprint and facing us, is a young wood-elf ranger who looks seventeen or eighteen: short deep-green hair, long pointed ears with a small copper bell clipped to the tip of one, worn leather armour polished by use with patches on the knees, a short bow on her back and a coil of red cord at her belt. In her right hand she holds up a glowing silver antler tine that she has just picked from the leaves, and looks at it; her left hand is spread flat on the earth beside the print. Her face is stricken and stubborn. Behind her on the right, standing in full profile facing left and looking into the dark wood, is the silver-haired elf princess: long straight silver-white hair, a ranger's travelling tunic and cloak in soft green and cream, her bow in her left hand at her side and her right hand resting on a root. In the far background three herb-gatherers with baskets huddle under a tree. Drifting threads of silk and silver motes float large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：采药人叫蛛群围在林边，月鹿王一路留下银色的枝角指向禁林，蹄印断在一片蛛丝上。月字不写。蛛群没画，只画丝。

nodes.name: 悬茧
nodes.light: a poisonous violet and rose glow from giant flowers on every side, against black-green shadow, with a small clean glint on the blade of a knife
nodes.camera: low on a bridge of woven vines, looking up at the ranger and the cocoons hanging above her; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night inside a garden gone wrong in the depths of an ancient forest: flowers as tall as houses, with fleshy violet and rose petals that glow, have grown into walls and corridors like a maze, and their pollen hangs in the air like smoke. Between them run bridges of living vines, and the far end of the bridge in front of us is slowly knitting itself shut. From silk ropes overhead hang a dozen cocoons, grey bundles the size of a person, turning slowly; from the nearest one a booted foot and a gloved hand stick out, and through a thin place in the silk we can see the face of a ranger, alive, eyes open and angry. Three spiders as big as oxen, with pale banded legs, cling upside down among the flowers above and watch. In the middle, standing on the vine bridge in full profile facing right, is a young wood-elf ranger: short deep-green hair, long pointed ears with a small copper bell on one, worn leather armour with patched knees, a short bow on her back. She is reaching up: her left hand grips the silk rope of the nearest cocoon to steady it, and her right hand holds a hunting knife laid against the rope, about to cut. Her jaw is set and her eyes are on the knife. At her feet, across the bridge, she has stretched a length of red cord from rail to rail, tied off, marking the way back. Pollen and loose silk drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：藤桥会合拢，毒花长成迷宫，失踪的巡林者被茧封住挂在半空。茧里的人活着。红绳是她圈地用的。希露菲没进画。

nodes.name: 三道粉笔
who: the dark-haired mage with twin tails
nodes.light: a deep orange-white glow from the sword blank on the anvil in the middle, pulsing like breath, against the warm brown dark of a smithy
nodes.camera: low beside the anvil, at the level of the chalk marks on its side, looking up at the smith and the glowing blank; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in a smith's workshop in a dwarven city under a mountain: walls of dressed black stone, racks of hammers and tongs, a banked forge, a quenching trough. On a great anvil in the middle lies an unfinished sword, a long rough blank of dark metal that glows orange-white from within, and the glow swells and fades slowly like breathing; a thin haze of heat rises from it and curls into shapes that are almost like words, without any letters. At the back of the room the shutter of a low window has been forced, and through the gap three goblins made of half-cooled lava, small and black with glowing cracks, are climbing in with their eyes on the blank. In the middle, kneeling on one knee at the side of the anvil in full profile facing right, is a young dwarf smith, a short sturdy woman about one hundred and thirty centimetres tall: red-brown braids tucked into a high leather collar, the outer half of her left eyebrow burnt away, a heavy leather apron, bare forearms crossed with old burn scars. Her right hand holds a stub of chalk and has just drawn the third of three short plain strokes on the dark side of the anvil; her left hand is cupped behind her ear, turned toward the blank, listening. Her mouth is a little open. In the doorway on the left, facing us, stands the dark-haired mage with twin tails: glossy black hair in two long tails, blue-green eyes, plain travelling clothes with a red coat. Her right hand is lifted with a small ruby light gathering at the fingertips, aimed at the window; her left hand holds the door frame. Sparks and curls of heat-haze drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：熔岩地精摸进工坊抢剑胚，剑胚报出三样东西，布琳拿粉笔一样一样记在砧边。剑胚说话画成一口气似的光，不画字。

nodes.name: 星铁
nodes.light: a cold blue-white glow from a lump of fallen star-iron in the rock, lighting the smith's face from the front, against black shadow, with one small warm lantern on the ground behind her
nodes.camera: close and low in the mine gallery, a little to one side of the smith, looking past her hands at the glowing ore; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the end of a gallery deep in an old mine driven into a mountain where a star once fell: rough black walls shored with timbers, a bent rail and an overturned ore cart, water dripping. In the rock face at the end of the gallery is sunk a lump of star-iron as big as a barrel, a mass of dark metal veined with lines that shine cold blue-white, and the frost of its light lies on everything near it. Around it the rock is scorched into the shape of a burst. Before it, standing in full profile facing right, is a young dwarf smith, a short sturdy woman about one hundred and thirty centimetres tall: red-brown braids tucked into a high leather collar, the outer half of her left eyebrow burnt away, a travel-stained leather apron over a long-sleeved shirt, a pack on her back. With long tongs in her left hand she has just drawn a splinter of the star-iron, as long as a hand, out of the rock, and she holds it up before her face; her right hand holds a small hammer hanging at her side. She is not looking at the splinter as a smith checks a piece of work. She is looking at it the way one looks at something one suddenly wants for oneself: her eyes are wide and bright with the blue light, and the beginning of a smile is on her face. On the ground behind her stands a lantern beside a chalk-marked stone, and far back along the gallery, small and dark, the outline of a guardian of the mine, a hulking thing of ore and crystal, lies broken. Flakes of frost-light and rock dust drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：坠星矿井里取星铁碎片。走到半路布琳不再只想着替一个传说收尾，动了打自己的兵器的念头。凛没进画。

nodes.name: 心室
who: the crimson-haired mage in the black battle coat
nodes.light: a restless blue-white flicker from the thing caged in the core, throwing hard moving shadows of gears, against red-brown steam-lit dark
nodes.camera: from a catwalk high in the chamber, close to the two women, looking down and across at the core; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the heart chamber deep inside a colossal ancient machine that is walking: a vault of riveted iron full of turning gears as large as mill wheels, pistons driving up and down, pipes leaking white steam, the whole room swaying with each step so that chains hang at a slant. In the middle hangs the core: a sphere of brass rings and thick glass as big as a house, held in a cradle of struts, and inside it something alive is coiled, a creature made of pure lightning, bird-headed and long-bodied, beating against the glass; each time it strikes, blue-white arcs jump along the struts. One thick black cable, newer than everything else in the room and roughly spliced, runs into the side of the core. On a narrow iron catwalk in the foreground stand two women. On the right, in full profile facing left toward the core, is a young dwarf engineer, a short sturdy woman about one hundred and thirty centimetres tall: short braids, brass goggles pulled down over her eyes, an oil smear on her cheek, patched overalls with a wrench in the pocket. Her left hand grips the rail; her right hand holds up a large iron key on its chain toward the core, and she is leaning forward, squinting, working something out. On the left, seen directly from behind, stands the crimson-haired mage in the black battle coat, long straight crimson hair lifting in the charged air; her right hand is stretched out flat toward the core with the fingers spread, feeling it, and small sparks crawl between her fingers. Steam, sparks and drops of hot oil drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：一路钻进机身深处，唤醒机神的是藏在它核心里的雷。那条私接进核心的黑电缆画了，谁接的不画。

nodes.name: 导雷
who: the crimson-haired mage in the black battle coat
nodes.light: one colossal river of blue-white lightning rising from the mage's hands into the sky, against a black storm, with every edge of the machine outlined in electric light
nodes.camera: from below on the cliff edge, looking steeply up at the machine's shoulder where the mage stands and at the lightning above her; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night at the very edge of a roaring cliff above a gulf. An ancient digging machine as tall as a cathedral, with dozens of jointed arms and a ruined factory on its back, has stopped with one colossal iron foot already at the brink; stones are falling from under the toe into the dark. The whole machine has turned to thunder: lightning runs over every plate and along every arm, its joints blaze white, and round its limbs and chest turn great rings of crackling light like shackles, three of them already broken and hanging open. It fills the picture and is cut off by the frame on every side. High on its shoulder, on a shelf of riveted plate, stands the crimson-haired mage in the black battle coat, facing us: long straight crimson hair flung straight upward by the charge, amber-gold eyes blazing, the coat whipping. Both her arms are raised above her head with the palms turned to the sky, and from between her hands the machine's lightning is being drawn out of it in one thick twisting river that climbs into the clouds and spreads there like the crown of a tree, lighting the whole storm from inside. Her feet are braced wide, her teeth are set, and her gloves are smoking; she is unhurt. At her feet a round hatch in the plating stands open with light pouring up out of it, and the end of a short braid and a small hand holding an iron key are just vanishing down into it. Sparks, rain and shards of light streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：机神在崖边整个化成了雷，外壳上锁着雷锁，艾莉娅替它导走那一身雷，露姆钻进核心。雷锁画成一圈一圈的光，露姆只露半截辫子和拿钥匙的手。

nodes.name: 唱歌的蘑菇
who: the lower-city thief with the faded red scarf
nodes.light: soft blue, green and gold glows from hundreds of mushrooms on every side, with the white glow of the lamp in the fox-eared girl's arms, against the deep violet dark of the wood
nodes.camera: low on the path among the mushroom stems, a wide side view of the two walking, with the net far ahead on the right; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on a path through a wood of giant mushrooms in rolling hills: stems as thick as trees, caps as wide as roofs, glowing soft blue, green and gold, and they are singing: from every cap, rings of pale light pulse outward through the air like ripples of sound. Small glowing spores rise everywhere. The path winds from left to right. On the left of the middle, walking along it in full profile facing right, come two girls side by side. Nearer to us is a beast-eared fox girl of sixteen: russet hair, two fox ears on top of her head, the left one upright and the right one flopped over, a bushy fox tail with a bare tip, plain market clothes with long loose sleeves. She hugs to her chest with both arms a glowing lamp, a globe of soft white light in a cage of brass filigree, and she walks with her head tilted, one ear turned to the singing, wide-eyed; she is unhurt and no one is near her but her companion. Beyond her, half a step ahead, walks the lower-city thief with the faded red scarf: a warm dark brown ponytail, a dark grey hooded jacket. Her right hand is raised in front of the fox girl's chest, palm back, stopping her; her left hand is on a knife at her belt; her eyes are narrowed at the path ahead. Far ahead on the right, well clear of them both, a wide net of dark cord is stretched across the path between two stems, almost invisible, and behind the further stem the shoulder and the hat brim of a waiting man show as a black outline. Spores and rings of pale light drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：往旧月圣所去的路上，唱歌的蘑菇林，盗猎头领皮尔斯的网在林口上等着。铃铃十六岁，照未成年画，网离她远。皮尔斯只画帽檐和肩。

nodes.name: 喉中灯
who: the lower-city thief with the faded red scarf
nodes.light: a white glow shining out of the wolf's open throat above, through a body of black smoke, against a starless night, with a faint warm glow of village lamps far below
nodes.camera: low on the hilltop, close behind the crouching thief, looking steeply up into the jaws of the wolf; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on the bare top of a hill above rolling country. Over the hilltop stands a wolf as tall as a tower, made of black smoke and shadow with a ragged mane and pale burning eyes; it fills the picture and is cut off by the frame at the top and on both sides. Its head is lowered toward us and its jaws are open in a roar, and deep in its throat, seen through the smoke of its neck, a small steady white light is shining: a lamp swallowed whole, still lit, a globe of white light in a cage of brass filigree. With each roar the light inside flickers and the smoke of the body thins around it. All round the hill, below, a ring of lesser wolves of black smoke sit and wait. In the near foreground, on a flat rock, the lower-city thief with the faded red scarf crouches seen directly from behind: a warm dark brown ponytail, a dark grey hooded jacket. Her left hand is flat on the rock; her right hand holds a hooked line coiled and ready to throw; her knees are bent to spring, her head tipped back, looking straight up the wolf's throat at the light. Far down the slope behind the wolf, small and safe behind a boulder, the tips of two fox ears and one bright eye show, watching. A man's wide-brimmed hat lies trampled on the grass. Shreds of black smoke and sparks of white light streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：月狼王吞下了月灯，在山顶化成巨兽，灯芯还亮着，在它的喉咙深处，米娅要去抢。铃铃躲得远，只露耳尖。月字不写，狼王写成黑烟的巨狼。

nodes.name: 剑指
who: the wine-red-haired demon princess in the black field coat
nodes.light: a violet glow streaming from the bound sword held out ahead, against the rust-red dark of a tunnel, with white sparks from the wheels and dim work lamps flashing past
nodes.camera: low on the roof of the speeding carriage, behind both figures, looking forward along the train into the tunnel of machines; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an armoured train is tearing through a disused underground branch line that has turned into a maze of machinery: the tunnel is ribbed with giant cogwheels still turning, swinging counterweights, half-open iron shutters and hanging signal arms, and tracks divide and loop away into the dark on every side; old work lamps streak past. We are on the roof of a carriage near the front. Ahead of us on the roof, in the middle of the picture, stands a young swordsman in plain black travelling clothes, seen directly from behind, his feet braced wide against the wind. His right arm is stretched straight out in front of him, level, and at the end of it his hand, wrapped in fraying strips of old cloth from which thin smoke is rising, grips a long black sword bound with iron bands and wax seals; the sword points dead ahead like the needle of a compass, and a stream of violet light runs forward from its point into the dark, bending where the track bends. It is plain that the sword is pulling the arm. His left hand is clamped round his own right wrist, trying to hold it back. The strap of a white mask shows at the back of his head. Three of the seals on the sword have broken and are flying back past us. In the near foreground on the left, kneeling on one knee on the roof in full profile facing right, is the wine-red-haired demon princess in the black field coat, long wine-red hair streaming straight back, two small black horns; her left hand grips a roof rail and her right hand is stretched out toward his back. Sparks, flying seals and shreds of steam streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：列车扎进废弃的渊月支线，那里早成了机械的迷宫。是剑在使唤他的手，去找它自己的本体。他只画背影，左手攥着自己的右腕。

nodes.name: 桥上
who: the wine-red-haired demon princess in the black field coat
nodes.light: a hard violet glow from inside the towering thing of blades on the bridge, against a black sky, with cold lamps along the parapets and red reflections on wet stone
nodes.camera: low on the roadway of the bridge, close to the two people in the foreground, looking up at the thing that towers over the far end; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on a long stone bridge leading to the citadel of a black obsidian capital; cold lamps burn along its parapets and the armoury towers of the citadel stand at its far end. Over the far end of the bridge rises a demon built of weapons: a giant in the rough shape of an armoured swordsman, as tall as the towers, cut off by the top of the frame, its body made of thousands of black obsidian blades, halberds, shields and cannon barrels locked together, with violet light burning in the gaps. Its right arm is one enormous black sword. From the armoury towers behind it, streams of swords, spears and plates of armour are flying through the air and sinking into its body, and it grows as we watch. In the foreground on the right, on one knee on the roadway and facing us, is a young man in plain black travelling clothes: a white mask with black markings has split and half of it has fallen away, showing the left half of a very young, pale face with a dark hollow under the eye; that eye is open and clear. His right hand, its wrappings burnt to shreds, is empty at last and rests open on his knee; his left hand is braced on the ground. He is breathing hard and looking at his empty hand. Beside him on the left, standing in full profile facing right toward the demon, is the wine-red-haired demon princess in the black field coat, long wine-red hair and two small black horns, a coiled whip in her right hand and her left hand held down toward him, open, offering to pull him up. Violet sparks and splinters of black glass streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：魔剑化成黑曜剑魔，吸食皇城的军械。鬼面裂了半张，底下是一张很年轻的脸，眼下青黑，人醒过来了。他几岁卡里是 980 年生，二十一。

nodes.name: 撬锁
who: the red-haired dragonkin champion in black plate with a tattered crimson cape
nodes.light: a creeping red-orange glow of lava from the tunnel on the left, against the black of a rock-cut cell, with a small warm ember-light from the little dragon's own scales
nodes.camera: low on the floor of the cell, close to the kneeling girl and the little dragon, looking past them at the tunnel mouth; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a rock-cut cell at the bottom of a mine under a volcano, part of an armoury works: iron rings in the walls, a rack of measuring rods and scorched test plates, and beyond a low arch on the left a mine tunnel into which a tongue of glowing lava is slowly creeping. A stone-and-iron guard golem lies toppled across the threshold, its eye dark. In the middle of the cell crouches a red dragon whelp no bigger than a large dog, a small Western wyrm with stubby bat-like wings, bright red scales that give off a faint ember glow, and wide wet golden eyes; a heavy iron collar is locked round its neck and chained to the wall, and it has shrunk back as far as the chain allows. Kneeling in front of it, in full profile facing right, is a young horned demon-kin woman of eighteen, a smith's apprentice: ash-silver hair tied back in a rough high tail with one red cord braided into it, two short horns showing through her fringe, plain smooth dark horn like a goat's with no scales on them, the tip of the left one chipped off flat; she is not a dragonkin, and her skin is smooth everywhere, with no scales on her neck, her face or her arms; strong forearms crossed with burn scars, a leather apron with a row of nails pinned along its bib over a long-sleeved shirt. Her left hand holds the big padlock of the collar steady; her right hand works a bent nail in its keyhole. Her eyes are narrowed in concentration and her lips are moving, speaking low to the whelp, which is looking not at the lock but at her face. In the arch on the left, seen directly from behind, stands the red-haired dragonkin champion in black plate with a tattered crimson cape, huge and broad, filling the opening; his left hand is braced on the rock and his right hand holds his weapon, and the glow of the lava outlines him. Embers and flecks of ash drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：看守的魔像倒下，阿妮娅撬开那道照她自己的样式打的锁，熔岩的洪流漫进矿道。阿妮娅十八岁，角魔短角，左角尖崩了一小块。

nodes.name: 火冠
who: the red-haired dragonkin champion in black plate with a tattered crimson cape
nodes.light: a clear golden-red light from a crown of flame hanging over a pedestal in the middle, against the darker red of falling lava on every side and black rock
nodes.camera: low on the causeway, a wide side view with the champion on the left and the crown in the middle, the lava falls rising out of the frame behind; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the heart of a volcano: a cavern so high that its roof is lost in smoke, down whose walls lava pours in slow shining falls into a lake of fire. A narrow causeway of black basalt runs out to an island in the lake, and on the island stands a rough pedestal of rock. Above the pedestal, turning slowly in the air, hangs a crown made of living flame, a ring of clear golden-red fire with seven tall points, steady and bright, quite unlike the sullen red of the lava. In niches high in the cavern wall, huge figures of flame with horned heads are stirring and turning to look. On the left, on the causeway before the island, in full profile facing right, stands the red-haired dragonkin champion in black plate with a tattered crimson cape: huge and broad-shouldered, short dark-red hair with two small horn-like ridges, fine red scales on his neck. His right arm is stretched out toward the crown, the gauntlet open, and the light of the crown lies golden on his face; his left hand holds his weapon upright beside him. He is calm and reverent. Three paces behind him, also in full profile facing right, stands a young horned demon-kin woman in a leather apron, ash-silver hair tied back in a rough high tail with one red cord braided into it, two short smooth dark horns through her fringe with no scales on them, her skin smooth everywhere with no scales on her neck, face or arms (she is not a dragonkin), shielding her eyes with her left forearm; on her back, clinging with its small wings folded, rides a red dragon whelp the size of a large dog, its golden eyes fixed on the crown. Far back along the causeway, small and dark, come four armoured riders on scaled mounts, each carrying a long lance with a burning tip. Embers and curls of flame drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：熔岩瀑布和炎魔的巢穴深处藏着能让母龙平静下来的赤焰王冠，工坊派的火枪骑士跟在后头。火枪骑士写成举着火尖长枪的骑手，不画枪械。
